entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: A Merfolk empire of the Domains on Dominaria, located in the depths of the Voda Sea; the largest empire on Dominaria.

entities.name: Old Vodalia
entities.description: The vast underwater country around Sarpadia, founded before the Brothers' War and destroyed by Homarid raiders around 170 AR.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Vodalia lies.

entities.name: Voda Sea
entities.description: The sea off the coast of Aerona in whose depths Vodalia lies.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Empress of Vodalia who emerged thousands of years into the future, refounded the empire as New Vodalia and ruled for a millennium until killed by Yawgmoth's deathcloud.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler who took the form of a huge deathcloud that killed most of Vodalia.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrificed his life to stop the deathcloud from reaching the Eliterates.

entities.name: Destry
entities.description: An Eliterate actor who posed as Emperor Omen, a moderate captain who became ruler and rebuilt New Vodalia into a democratic society.

entities.name: Mihail II
entities.description: The current sovereign of Vodalia in the Mending Era.

entities.name: Annika
entities.description: The empress of Vodalia, wife of Emperor Mihail II.

entities.name: Felisia
entities.description: Intelligent and opinionated daughter of Mihail II and Annika.

entities.name: Marja
entities.description: Quiet, thoughtful daughter of Mihail II and Annika.

entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: The goddess of the Pearl moon, worshipped by Vodalians.

entities.name: Eliterates
entities.description: An artistic commune in a deep trench set up to escape Vodalian society, instrumental in rebuilding Vodalia.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: A cryptic, cold-loving crustacean race that destroyed Old Vodalia and has long warred with the merfolk.

entities.name: Order of the Pearl Trident
entities.description: The elite warriors of Empress Galina.

entities.name: Akula Current
entities.description: A younger corps of the Imperial Vodalian Army that provokes confrontations and annexes trading ports.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria, near the end of which Yawgmoth's deathcloud devastated Vodalia.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: The collapse around 170 AR during which Old Vodalia was destroyed by Homarids.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: An independent merfolk colony defeated by Galina.

events.summary: Old Vodalia is destroyed by raiding Homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.
events.quote: was destroyed by raiding creatures called Homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires around 170 AR

events.summary: Empress Galina emerges thousands of years in the future, defeats Etlan Shiis, and refounds her empire as New Vodalia.
events.quote: Galina reformed her empire as "New Vodalia"

events.summary: Yawgmoth's deathcloud kills most of Vodalia and Galina, ending her thousand-year reign.
events.quote: Galina was one of the many casualties, ending her thousand-year reign.

events.summary: Bo Levar sacrifices his life to keep the deathcloud from reaching the Eliterates.
events.quote: The planeswalker Bo Levar sacrificed his life to prevent the cloud from reaching the Eliterates

events.summary: Emperor Omen, secretly the actor Destry, takes up the government and rebuilds Vodalia as a democratic society, later faking his death.
events.quote: Omen rebuilt New Vodalia into a democratic, benevolent society

events.summary: The waves shelter Vodalia from the devastation of the Rift Era.
events.quote: The waves sheltered Vodalia from the devastation of the Rift Era

events.summary: The Akula Current provokes confrontations and annexes trading ports using falsified incidents.
events.quote: has used falsified incidents as an excuse to annex trading ports in various coastal regions

relations.note: Empress who ruled New Vodalia for a thousand years.
relations.quote: an empire that lasted for a millennium under her rule
The elite warriors of Galina were the Order of the Pearl Trident.
Emperor Mihail II is the current sovereign.
merfolk have waged bitter, generations-long wars against other subsurface peoples
Yawgmoth took the form of a huge deathcloud that killed everything it touched
